text: Only sweet whey (from rennet cheese) has it. Because GMP contains no phenylalanine, people with phenylketonuria can eat it as their protein source, in puddings, drinks and bars, instead of a bitter amino-acid formula.

links.name: LaClair, Ney, MacLeod & Etzel 2009, J Food Sci 74(4): E199–E206

steps.note: The whey is run over a resin at pH 4, where the glycomacropeptide is not held.

steps.what: histidine, tryptophan, tyrosine, arginine and cysteine
steps.note: They are added as the glycomacropeptide lacks them, so the food is complete for phenylketonuria.
